title: Te Whakapono i Muri i te Torona
intro: Ko ētahi wairua kāore e whakamatautauria e te ahi, e te waipuke rānei, engari e te pēhanga puhoi o te noho i roto i te whare o te kaitukino. I tū tēnei tangata i te taha o tētahi rangatira i kī he atua ia ki runga i ō rātou iwi, engari i piri puku ki te whakapono ki te Atua Pono Kotahi. I te kitenga o tō rātou aroha, ka puta te mamae - engari i puta mai anō hoki tētahi kupu whakaari atua. Ka taea e koe te matapae ko wai tēnei?
clues: I noho ahau i raro i te tuanui o te rangatira tino mana o tōku whenua, i roto i te tūranga e kore e taea e te hunga ruarua te whakaaro.
I tū taku hoa rangatira i mua i te iwi, ā, i kī ia he atua ia — engari nō te Ariki Pono Kotahi tōku ngākau.
I hāhā puku ahau i aku inoi, i te wehi kei pā ki te hunga katoa e whakakeke ana ki taku hoa rangatira.
I te huraina o tōku whakapono, i hopukina ahau, i whakamamaetia hoki - heoi, kāore rawa tōku arero i puaki i tētahi kupu whakaponokore.
I ringihia e ahau tōku ngākau ki tōku Ariki, i te tono mō tētahi whare i Pararaiha, kia matara atu i ngā mahi hē katoa.
Ko Asiya ahau, te wahine a te Parao i whakahē ki a Mohi rāua ko Harun.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Asiya bint Muzahim (Wahine a Parao)
Ko Hāwa (Ewa), te wahine tuatahi
Ko Sarah, te wahine tuatahi a Ibrahim
Ko Hakara, te whaea o Ihimaera
Te whaea o Meriama (te wahine a Imrana)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakamanawanui ki te whakamamae mō te kore e whakarērea te whakapono
E ora tonu ana i roto i te puku o te ika nui
Te hanga i tētahi āka nui hei mawhiti i te waipuke
Te maka ki roto i te ahi mura
Te kitenga i te wehenga o te moana nui
trial.answer: Te whakamanawanui ki te whakamamae mō te kore e whakarērea te whakapono

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He whare i hangaia mō rātou i Pararaiha
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He āka e kawe ana i ngā takirua o ia mea hanga
He kuao kau koura e karakiatia ana e te iwi
He koti hei patu i tētahi toa nunui
location.answer: He whare i hangaia mō rātou i Pararaiha

outcome.label: Hua
options: Ka whakahonoretia ki te noho ki Pararaiha i te taha o te hunga tika
I toremi i raro i ngā ngaru me tā rātou ope taua
I tahuna ki te mura engari i whakaorangia e te wawaotanga a te Atua
I horomia e tetahi mea nui, kātahi ka maka ki uta
I riro hei tangata whai rawa rawa atu o tōna wā
outcome.answer: Ka whakahonoretia ki te noho ki Pararaiha i te taha o te hunga tika

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
